Portrait: A rescue hero's costume made to be seen through smoke and dust: a bright jacket and trousers with wide reflective silver bands across the chest, upper arms and shins, a chest harness with reinforced loops, elbow and knee pads, light work gloves and sturdy waterproof boots. Default colors: safety orange and silver, replaced by the character's established costume colors when stated. No lettering or medical symbols. Cut openings for any established wings, tail or extra arms.

Portrait only: inventory and equipped items stay as they are. Keep the character's actual adult age, body plan and any Mutant features; the garment adds no Quirk effect, gear function, rank, license or affiliation. Respect the selected crop.
